@colibri/react.reason: Support consumer migrations with explicit wallet authorization entries, optional async clients, structural client identity and shared query utilities. Add complete provider, wallet, combined signer and wallet-contract conveniences, with dedicated failure classes.
@colibri/react.apiReview: Additive APIs preserve current hooks and explicit signing policies. Generated client identity no longer depends on private Core class fields. ABI keys use full-content SHA-256 fingerprints; disabled clients cannot fetch. Wallet authorization validates address, network, expiry and payload preservation. Token precision reads share a five-minute cache. Existing granular APIs remain. Explicit transaction fields override wallet defaults. Each REACT code has a concrete exported class; base catches and legacy constructors remain source compatible.

@colibri/core.reason: Expose a distinct concrete error class for each stable failure code and emit these classes from library code.
@colibri/core.apiReview: Additive concrete subclasses and code registries preserve existing codes, messages, metadata, family-level instanceof handling and legacy constructor signatures. Library-owned failures use dedicated classes; legacy family constructors remain compatibility extension points. Core custom consumer error codes remain supported.
